top_deficiency_types.title: Have a policy regarding use and storage of foods brought to residents by family and other visitors.

Ensure services provided by the nursing facility meet professional standards of quality.

top_deficiency_types.title: Allow residents to easily view the nursing home's survey results and communicate with advocate agencies.

top_deficiency_types.title: Provide timely notification to the resident, and if applicable to the resident representative and ombudsman, before transfer or discharge, including appeal rights.
